main.description: Publish the edition records a reader is about to reference, and return the uri+cid a shelf record's strongRef needs. The AppView calls this when a reader acts — shelves a book, marks a status — never on a page render: a crawl must not republish the catalogue, and a strongRef cannot be written before the record exists. The caller authenticates with an atproto service token minted by its own PDS, so the request proves an intent rather than a page view.

errors.description: The service token was missing or rejected.
errors.name: AuthRequired

errors.description: The body named no identifier or uri, or too many.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

identifiers.description: Edition identifiers as search returns them. At most 100 entries across identifiers and uris.

uris.description: Edition uris as resolveEditions returns them (the `atproto` identifier), when the caller already has them.

waitMs.description: How long the AppView may wait for a record to be written before the uri is reported as pending. Defaults to 2000; capped at 5000.

editions.description: Editions whose records exist now. The cid is what a strongRef must carry.

pending.description: Uris whose publication was requested but not written within waitMs. The caller may retry; the request stays queued.
